comparison.objective: Jack up a heavy beam, support it on two stands, then reach underneath; only a task-path body is provided.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy-load lifting, redundant support placement, and safety sequencing, not millimetre-scale impact tooling.
comparison.success_condition: Beam is supported on both stands before reaching underneath; numeric stability criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Load support and safe access are meaningfully different from tang fracture, insert retention, and debris recovery.
